persona.name: Alex Martin
persona.note: Synthetic demo persona. Every person, number and appointment in this file is invented.

memories.text: Alex Martin is a product designer living in Lyon, in the Croix-Rousse district.
memories.label: profile

memories.text: The design team works in Figma for design files, Linear for tickets, Notion for specs and Slack for chat.
memories.label: team tools

memories.text: Half marathon in Lyon on Sunday 15 Nov 2026, with a goal of finishing under 1:50.
memories.label: half marathon

memories.text: Sister Léa turns 30 on Saturday 14 Nov 2026; she loves peonies, bouldering and terrible puns.
memories.label: sister's birthday

memories.text: Meeting preferences: nothing before 10:00, 25-minute slots by default, and an agenda shared the day before.
memories.label: meeting preferences

memories.text: Quarterly product review on Wednesday 4 Nov 2026 at 15:00, where the design team presents the onboarding redesign.
memories.label: quarterly product review

memories.text: Dermatologist appointment on Tuesday 3 Nov 2026 at 10:30.
memories.label: health appointment

memories.text: Weekly review, every Friday at 17:00: clear the inbox, check the calendar for the next two weeks, pick three priorities and log the week's running kilometres.
memories.label: weekly review

memories.text: Dinner with friends at the Lebanese place near Bellecour on Friday 6 Nov 2026 at 20:00.
memories.label: dinner with friends

memories.text: Monthly rent is €1,180, paid on the 5th of each month.
memories.label: housing cost

memories.text: Confidential: final-round interview for a lead designer role on Thursday 5 Nov 2026 at 11:00 (video call); not to be mentioned at work.
memories.label: private appointment

memories.text: Partner Sam is vegetarian, so dinner plans need a good veggie option.
memories.label: partner's diet

memories.text: Gift idea for Léa: a bouldering day pass and a small bunch of peonies.
memories.label: gift idea

memories.text: To do: book a table for Léa's birthday dinner by Tuesday 10 Nov 2026.
memories.label: birthday dinner booking

memories.text: To do: send the onboarding redesign slides to the product team before the quarterly review.
memories.label: review slides

memories.text: Running club track session every Tuesday at 19:00 at the Gerland stadium.
memories.label: track session

memories.text: Long run every Sunday morning along the Rhône quays at an easy 5:45 per km.
memories.label: long run routine

memories.text: Prefers trains over planes for trips under five hours and usually books a window seat.
memories.label: travel preference

memories.text: Usual coffee order: oat flat white, no sugar.
memories.label: coffee order

memories.text: Learning Italian on weekday mornings ahead of a spring 2027 trip to Turin.
memories.label: language learning

memories.text: Savings goal: €6,000 by June 2027 for a sabbatical month.
memories.label: savings

memories.text: Design critique happens every Wednesday at 14:00 in the team's critique channel.
memories.label: design critique

memories.text: Accessibility checklist for every screen: 4.5:1 text contrast, visible focus states, 44 px touch targets and no colour-only meaning.
memories.label: accessibility checklist

memories.text: Race shoes: the carbon-plated pair is for race day only; daily trainers for everything else.
memories.label: race shoes

memories.text: Running club coach's advice for race week: keep a little intensity but cut weekly volume by about 40 percent.
memories.label: taper advice
